concerns.text: FR-001 mandates stratifying a subset of the 'Voices-in-the-Wild-2M' dataset. Tasks T007a/b and the Plan explicitly substitute LibriSpeech and CORAA-MUPE-ASR. No task exists to implement the FR-001 requirement for the specified dataset, leaving the spec requirement unimplemented.

FR-011 requires validating SSS against human annotations *before* defining the collapse threshold. The task graph (T050b -> US2/US3) forces US2/US3 to depend on the manual completion of T050b. No task exists to implement the automated validation logic required by FR-011 that would allow the pipeline to proceed without a manual human-in-the-loop bottleneck.

FR-004 and FR-009 define collapse intensity based on SSS (0.5 threshold) and WER spike. The Plan introduces 'Human-Validated Collapse Margin (HVCM)' as the regression target. Tasks T030b and T026 implement HVCM training, but no task exists to implement the FR-004/FR-009 logic for SSS/WER-based collapse detection as the primary target, creating a gap between spec requirements and implemented tasks.

FR-002 requires applying 54 distinct compound distortion scenarios. Task T012 generalizes this to a 'variable count of scenarios' and 'qualitative description'. No task enforces the specific quantitative requirement of 54 scenarios or verifies this count in the output.

SC-002 requires measuring and reporting the stability of the 'critical interaction vector' via sensitivity analysis. Task T053 raises a RuntimeError if variance > 10% but does not include a task to generate the required report artifact (`data/derived/sensitivity_analysis.csv`) to measure and report the stability as mandated by the success criterion.

Task T008 is marked as '[X]' (complete) in the list but is explicitly described as 'rejected' and missing in the re-plan section notes. This internal inconsistency creates confusion regarding the completion status of the pytest configuration.
